description: This Python module defines an OrderService class responsible for handling order checkout, creation, and retrieval functions within an e-commerce backend. It interacts with database models, manages shopping cart validation, stock updates, order creation, and retrieval of user orders.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Service handling checkout and order management, including creating orders, validating stock, updating inventory, and retrieving user orders.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the OrderService with a database session and an instance of CartService.

methods.name: models.Order checkout(self, user_id: int, method: str, address)
methods.description: Performs the checkout process: validates cart, stock, creates address, order, order items, updates stock and total, then clears the cart.

methods.name: list_user_orders(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all orders for a given user, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Optional[models.Order] get_user_order(self, user_id: int, order_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order for a user by order ID, returning None if not found.

ctags.name: checkout
ctags.pattern: /^    def checkout(self, user_id: int, method: str, address) -> models.Order:$/

ctags.name: get_user_order
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_user_order(self, user_id: int, order_id: int) -> Optional[models.Order]:$/
